topic_title: Yielding to Emergency Vehicles, School Buses & Pedestrians
prompt: When an authorized emergency vehicle approaches with audible siren and flashing red/blue lights, what must you do?

options.text: Accelerate rapidly to the nearest intersection and make a sharp turn
Maintain your lane position and speed so the emergency vehicle passes
Pull over immediately to the right edge or curb of the road and stop
Stop immediately in your current travel lane without pulling to the side
